# forumulate_status_component (Resource)

A component of a status page: an HTTP, heartbeat, protocol (TCP, UDP, ping, DNS, TLS, SMTP, IMAP, POP3, domain), browser, manual, rolled-up or vendor-mirrored check.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_status_component" "api" {
  space_id         = var.status_space_id
  name             = "API"
  url              = "https://api.example.com/health"
  group            = "Core"
  regions          = ["eu-west", "us-east"]
  confirm_regions  = 2
  bar_days         = 90
  interval_seconds = 60
}

resource "forumulate_status_component" "database" {
  space_id   = var.status_space_id
  name       = "Database"
  kind       = "tcp"
  group      = "Core"
  probe_json = jsonencode({ host = "db.example.com", port = 5432 })
}

resource "forumulate_status_component" "nightly_backup" {
  space_id         = var.status_space_id
  name             = "Nightly backup"
  kind             = "heartbeat"
  interval_seconds = 90000
  display          = "status"
}

output "backup_ping_url" {
  value = forumulate_status_component.nightly_backup.ping_url
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `space_id` (String) The status page (space) id.

### Optional

- `alerts_enabled` (Boolean) Alerts fire when it goes down. Default true.
- `bar_days` (Number) Its own day strip length on the board: 30, 60 or 90. Unset follows the theme.
- `cert_expiry_days` (Number) Days a TLS certificate must have left (https).
- `confirm_regions` (Number) How many regions must see it failing before it reads down.
- `description` (String) A sentence shown beside its name.
- `display` (String) `bars` (default), `status` or `hidden-unless-degraded`.
- `expect_status` (Number) The exact HTTP status that means up; unset keeps the under-400 rule.
- `failure_threshold` (Number) Failed checks in a row before it reads down (1–10).
- `group` (String) The group it is listed under.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks, or the longest wait for a heartbeat's ping.
- `keyword` (String) A term the body must contain (or must not, with `keyword_absent`).
- `keyword_absent` (Boolean) Fail while `keyword` is in the body.
- `kind` (String) `http` (default), `heartbeat`, `manual`, `space`, `statuspage`, `instatus`, `betterstack`, `feed`, `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `dns`, `tls`, `smtp`, `imap`, `pop3`, `domain` or `browser`. Fixed at creation.
- `link_url` (String) Where its own docs or product live.
- `method` (String) `GET` (default), `HEAD` or `POST`.
- `paused` (Boolean) Kept on the page with its history, not probed.
- `probe_json` (String) A protocol or browser check's probe as JSON (`jsonencode({ host = "db.example.com", port = 5432 })`): `host`, `port`, `record`, `resolver`, `expect`, `payload`, `days`, `url`, `selector`.
- `region` (String) Where it runs ("EU"), for grouping by region.
- `regions` (List of String) Probe regions it is checked from (see the API's `GET …/status/regions`). Empty: the primary checker.
- `show_uptime` (Boolean) Print its uptime figure beside the strip. Default true.
- `slug` (String) Its stable address within the page; minted from the name when unset.
- `url` (String) The address to poll (`http`) or the vendor page (`statuspage`, `instatus`, `betterstack`, `feed`).
- `visible` (Boolean) Listed on the public page. Default true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ping_url` (String) Heartbeat only: where the job pings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_status_component.api STATUS_SPACE_ID/COMPONENT_ID
```
